scientific_integrity: Exact bivariate identity proved by boundary-cycle matching enumeration and deletion; joint limit uses the classical marginal Gaussian theorem. Enumeration is finite corroboration, not an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Not a claim of finite independence; no independent historical-priority audit; an earlier multivariate crossing-and-short-chord enumerator may imply the result; the displayed covariance itself was previously known.
title: Exact short-chord/crossing transfer and independent Poisson–Gaussian limits
